learnings.claim: Contribution culling buys speed but aggregate low-opacity detail makes a universal cutoff unsafe.
learnings.evidence: P1 moving reductions: 31.7% bee, 5.7% shop, 5.5% 16M and 11.9% 32M. Minimum foreground PSNR losses: 9.555, 0.039, 0.351 and 4.034 dB respectively.
learnings.implication: Keep cutoff opt-in; preserve total projected coverage if replacing it with a new reduction operator.

learnings.claim: A two-pixel cutoff after contribution culling did not add a consistent speed benefit.
learnings.evidence: P2 has nearly the same minimum PSNR as P1 but is slower at the pooled moving median on all four inputs; two trials do not establish a small timing difference as causal.
learnings.implication: Do not stack additional cutoffs merely because they are defaults.

learnings.claim: Native whole-bank cached SH did not dominate current-view visible SH.
learnings.evidence: Shop p95 14.54 ms cached versus 8.19 ms with the same culling and visible SH; SH0 city data cannot establish SH reuse benefit.
learnings.implication: Any new SH cache should avoid whole-bank refresh spikes and remain current enough on translated views.

ideas.title: Selected-ID SH cache
ideas.claim: Cache directional color only for selected visible permanent IDs and refresh changed directions incrementally.

provenance.evidence: Whole-bank cached SH has worse shop tails than visible-only evaluation. A smaller cache is not yet tested.
provenance.boundary: SH3 inputs; exact ID and per-splat direction validity must survive LOD and camera changes.

ideas.title: Coverage-preserving tiny-splat aggregation
ideas.claim: Replace groups of weak subpixel splats with screen-space representatives instead of discarding their opacity.

provenance.evidence: Contribution culling loses 9.6 dB on bee and 4 dB on 32M city despite speed gains. Preserving aggregate coverage may repair the failure.
provenance.boundary: Approximate; differing depth and SH prohibit indiscriminate pixel-bin merges.

ideas.title: One-time physical bank locality
ideas.claim: Order each immutable bank spatially while retaining a permanent logical-to-physical ID map.

provenance.evidence: All bank parameters remain resident and large-source traversal costs persist. Cache-local memory access is an untested orthogonal direction.
provenance.boundary: Must not enable loader reorder without updating ID maps, metadata digests and SH addressing.

components.claim: Store cached color keyed by permanent selected Gaussian ID.
Refresh only newly visible or direction-invalid cached colors.
Use per-splat view direction change, including translation, to invalidate color.
Moment-merge compatible tiny projected splats while preserving opacity rather than hard-culling them.
Restrict projected aggregation to bounded depth and color variation.
Estimate aggregate projected coverage of weak splats before replacing a group.
Use physically spatially ordered immutable parameter banks.
Preserve logical world IDs with a one-time bijective address remap.
Compare same-selected-ID renders and frame tails before considering locality a win.
